<subject>Re: Need to pay ORSAN bill by COB Tues 27/11. NOTICE OF ORSAN SUPPLY AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO ORSAN IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had satisfied ORSAN's credit requirements last week; however, below is a notice that the bill has not been paid and Lumière Santé will not be able to participate in ORSAN tenders if the bill is not paid by 27/11 COB.

Please let us know if Clinical Operations needs to call ORSAN to try to discuss this. Jacqueline 37007.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Cousin, Richard
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 9:20 AM
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel
Subject: FW: ORSAN SUPPLY AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO ORSAN IS OVERDUE



FYI

-----Original Message-----
From: d992@pexcorcorp.com [<mailto:d992@pexcorcorp.com>]
Sent: Tuesday, November 18, 2025 8:43 PM
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr
Cc: d742@sollumlabs.com; l184@sollumlabs.com
Subject: ORSAN SUPPLY AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th
PAYMENT TO ORSAN IS OVERDUE
Importance: High


> This is your formal notice that ORSAN now considers your company in breach of
> the ORSAN Master Supply Agreement for non-payment of your November 5, 2025 ORSAN
> invoice by 1 p.m. today. In accordance with the current provisions of Section
> 15.1.3 of ORSAN's Master Supply Agreement, you have three business days to rectify
> this breach by making full payment to ORSAN. If this breach is not rectified by
> the end of ORSAN's business day on Tuesday, November 25, 2025, ORSAN will declare
> your company in default and terminate your rights to participate at ORSAN
> committee meetings, to transact business in ORSAN's markets, and to receive
> supply chain services from ORSAN. Additionally, all ORSAN Members will receive a
> list tomorrow of companies that did not pay their invoice for October activity
> on the due date.
>
> If you have any questions regarding this notice or the amount your company
> owes to ORSAN, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at
> +33 4 71 47 75 05.
>
> Suzanne Daugherty
> Controller
</quoted>
